"""Stress: 4096 composed filter applications and large all-predicates."""
import json, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/tests')
from kbuild import *

DEPTH = 11  # 2^11 = 2048 leaves; each leaf has 2 sub -> keep total nodes ~4095
types = [
    {"name": "N8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
    {"name": "S8", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 8},
    {"name": "Arr64", "kind": "array", "element": "N8", "size": 64},
    {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"},
]
# Entry: params s: S8, arr: Arr64; result B; requires: all elements >= 3 and match(s)
mod = {"name": "e", "params": [["s", "S8"], ["arr", "Arr64"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
       "requires": ["and",
           ["all", "v", ["var", "arr"], ["ge", ["var", "v"], ["const", "N8", 3]]],
           ["match", ["var", "s"], "[a-z]*[0-9]"]]}
# Filter Fi has one param p: N8 and requires p != i; Fi's pipes bind sub-filters
# Build binary tree of depth DEPTH: filter level k has 2 pipes to level k+1 filters
filters = []
pipes = []
for k in range(DEPTH + 1):
    for j in range(2 ** k):
        filters.append({"name": "F%d_%d" % (k, j), "params": [["p", "N8"]],
                        "result": ["fr", "B"],
                        "requires": ["ne", ["var", "p"], ["const", "N8", (k + j) % 250]]})
for k in range(DEPTH):
    for j in range(2 ** k):
        for c in range(2):
            pipes.append({"target": "F%d_%d" % (k, j), "filter": "F%d_%d" % (k + 1, 2 * j + c),
                          "bind": {"p": "p"}})
pipes.append({"target": "e", "filter": "F0_0", "bind": {"p": "n"}})
mod2 = dict(mod)
mod2["params"] = [["s", "S8"], ["arr", "Arr64"], ["n", "N8"]]
def mk(sv, arrv, n, res, flagv):
    seq = [("x%d" % (1 + i), le(sv[i], 1)) for i in range(8)]
    seq += [("x%d" % (10 + i), le(arrv[i], 1)) for i in range(64)]
    seq += [("x74", le(n, 1)), ("x75", le(res, 1)), ("x76", le(flagv, 1))]
    return {"entry": "e", "ktest": b64(ktest(seq))}
def ms(s):
    return [ord(c) for c in s.ljust(8, '\x00')]
# n != 0 -> all F preds true (k+j %250 == 0 only for k=j=0 with p!=0 ok when n!=0)
runs = [mk(ms("abc3"), [3 + (i % 5) for i in range(64)], 1 + (r % 200), r & 1, 0) for r in range(200)]
campaign = {"types": types, "modules": [mod2] + filters, "calls": [], "pipes": pipes,
            "entries": ["e"], "machine": None, "runs": runs}
data = json.dumps(campaign).encode()
print("input bytes:", len(data), "applications:", 2 ** (DEPTH + 1) - 1)
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/project/campaign_cli.py'],
                   input=data, capture_output=True)
dt = time.time() - t0
print("rc=%d time=%.1fs out=%d" % (p.returncode, dt, len(p.stdout)))
out = json.loads(p.stdout)
sts = [r['status'] for r in out['records']]
assert all(s == 'READY' or s == 'DUPLICATE' for s in sts), set(sts)
assert sts[0] == 'READY' and sts[1] == 'DUPLICATE', sts[:3]
assert out['records'][0]['model_result'] == 0
assert out['records'][1]['model_result'] == 1
plan = out['plans'][0]
assert plan['flag'] == 'x76'
assert plan['variables'] == 77
assert len(plan['modules']) == 2 + 2 ** (DEPTH + 1) - 1 - 1 + 1 - 1  # loose
print("stress4 OK")
EOF
cd /workspace && time python3 /workspace/tmp/tests/stress4.py
